fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
Questions grouped by engagement driver

Core items on pride, intent to stay, advocacy, and extra effort come first. Driver sections on managers, growth, recognition, and workload follow. Reword any item with one sentence.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-2-content:
Anonymity thresholds you set

No dashboard shows results for a group with fewer than five answers, and comments carry no names or emails. The first screen states that rule before anyone answers a question.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Write it out in plain English: who gets it, which questions, the scale, the anonymity rule, and the reminder schedule. Emergent turns that into a working survey with its own response table and team dashboards. Later changes take one more message.
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build an employee engagement survey that scores engagement by team and keeps every answer confidential.
